sources.title: Meta SAM Model | [SAM 1, SAM 2, SAM 3 & SAM 3D]
sources.snippet: Discover the Meta SAM model family, from SAM 1 and SAM 2 to SAM 3 and SAM 3D. Learn how Segment Anything uses prompts, text, and 3D reconstruction to detect, segment, track, and rebuild any object in images and video.

sources.title: EfficientSAM3 - simonzeng7108.github.io
sources.snippet: SAM3 delivers Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) by combining semantic understanding and temporal tracking, yet its massive backbone and dense memory bank make on-device deployment impractical. EfficientSAM3 compresses SAM1, SAM2, and SAM3 into a family of lightweight student models tailored for edge hardware without sacrificing PCS quality.
